title: Draw a band around a line to show each year’s margin of error.
rule: Draw the series as a 2 px line in the subject ink over a band from each year’s low to its high at the publisher’s stated confidence, which the measure line names. Fill the band in Stone magnitude step 1 and draw its two edges as 1 px lines in the context ink, since the fill alone is too pale to see. Where the publisher changed its method, break the line and the band and draw both estimates for that year (Rule 14.11). Label the latest figure with its margin at the line’s end.
use_when: The reader asks how a survey figure changed over years and how sure each year’s figure is.

use_instead.when: A projection whose range widens ahead
A count with no sampling margin

text: A band shows at once which year-to-year moves are larger than the survey’s own uncertainty and which sit inside it. Breaking it where the method changed keeps a new questionnaire from reading as a change in people’s lives.
why.basis: Design judgment, from the chart system our founder and editor approved in November 2026

builders: Form line-confidence-band: node work/build/chart-kit/oa-chart.mjs build s58; encode x, y and margin (or low and high), with break and labels.break_end and labels.break_start for a change of method.
